plugin.slashDesc: Open an interactive HTML prototype with pin and box annotations

settings.defaultModeHint: Start in live interaction mode to click controls first, or go straight to pin/box markup.
settings.injectPromptHint: Append concise HTML prototype authoring conventions (data-screen, data-part, zero local port) when opening top-level agent sessions.
settings.copySnippetHint: Copy the prototype authoring rules to paste into your repository's AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md.
settings.skillsBundleHint: Installs pure-Markdown skills into ~/.agents/skills and ~/.claude/skills without overwriting existing skills.
settings.skill_html_prototype_craft_desc: Interactive HTML prototyping with data-screen/data-part markers and zero-port Paseo handoff (MIT).
settings.skill_frontend_design_desc: Anthropic's flagship frontend design lead skill for intentional typography, color, and anti-AI-slop craft (Apache-2.0).
settings.skill_baseline_ui_desc: Opinionated UI baseline for spacing, hierarchy, accessible primitives, and fast deslopping (MIT).
settings.skill_fixing_accessibility_desc: WCAG & ARIA audit rules for accessible names, keyboard navigation, focus traps, and form errors (MIT).
settings.skill_fixing_motion_performance_desc: Compositor-first CSS/JS motion rules to eliminate layout thrashing and frame drops (MIT).
settings.browserPathHint: Optional path on the daemon host used only when rendering interactive snapshots for iOS and Android clients.
